## Functions

### logTail

A log tail: the whole stream, appended, off a terminal; its last `height` rows on one.

```ts
function logTail({ height }?: LogTailOptions): Component<LogTailState>;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{ height }` (optional) | `LogTailOptions` |

**Returns** `Component<LogTailState>`

## Interfaces

### LogTailOptions

```ts
interface LogTailOptions {
    /** Rows the tail shows on a terminal. Default 5; anything below 1 is 1. */
    height?: number;
}
```

### LogTailState

```ts
interface LogTailState {
    /** Every entry the stream has produced so far, oldest first. */
    lines: readonly LogLine[];
}
```

## Types

### LogLine

One entry of the stream: a line of output, or the start of a step.

```ts
type LogLine = string | {
    step: string;
};
```
